mission.title: Strange Rumors
mission.description: Find out what the bluepills know about the street magician Cryptos, then eavesdrop on the Machines.

npc.say: I... I think you'd better go...
I'm sorry, we don't allow solicitations in the office.
If you haven't filed the forms, I can't help you.
Oh and hey -- if you get caught, I had nothing to do with this. Understand?

phase.briefing:
Have you heard the rumors yet? Or maybe you've seen for yourself? These strange boxes are appearing all over the city. According to the Sentinel, they're for some street magician named Cryptos. Yeah, right.
We need to know more about Cryptos. He may be a harmless bluepill entertainer... or he may be much, much more. We need you to investigate this for us.
We've found some bluepills who've seen him in action. Go talk to them and find out anything you can... how he gets in the boxes... what he says... how he leaves... just get answers! Your first witness is Jacquelyn Plunkett.

enter.say: This is Plunkett's workplace, so keep a low profile in there. See what she knows about Cryptos and then get out.

talk.say:
What? The boxes? Sure, I've seen one of them open. Some Rasta guy was in there and started ranting about all sortsa crap. None of it really made sense, but it was lunchtime and I was bored, so...
...Hey, who are you, anyway? Did you check in with Michelle?

done.say: All right, that's the first bluepill. Head out and we'll go check out the next one.

phase.briefing:
Okay, you know what? This isn't getting us anywhere. Interview the bluepills... get the info we already have... blah blah...
How about we try this: you go get a listening device. I'll get you to a Machine network node. We do a little eavesdropping and find out what they know.
Better than talkin' to coppertops all day, right? Go talk to Chaos, he'll hook you up.

enter.say: I wouldn't want to do anything to hurt our new friendship with the Machines... but I supposed if they don't find out...

objective.text: Get the listening device from Chaos

talk.say: Anome sent you, right? Yeah, I owe him one... here, take this.

done.say: Device in hand... you can head out of there.

phase.briefing:
All right. Let's see... this spot looks fine. The stupid toasters have let their guard down since we're all friends and whatever now.
Head there, find a computer, plant the device, and don't get caught. Think you can handle that?

enter.say: Okay... you need to be careful in there. If any Machines spot you, you're through. According to this readout, you should be able to pull it off, if you're careful. Just hit the computer, plant the device, and get out. Got it?

objective.text: Plant the listening device on the computer

done.say: Nice! Now get out of there before you're spotted.

mission.finish:
Not too bad, for a goodie two shoes. I'll have my people start analyzing those signals.
And don't tell anyone about this. Understand?
